name: MagicLab MagicDog-W
summary: A 22.5 kg wheel-leg robot dog with lidar and cameras that carries up to 10 kg at up to 3 m/s, for patrol, survey, research and demonstrations.

germany.statusNote: MagicLab sells on request and says it has sales and support teams in Germany; no German dealer is named for this model. Roboter Deutschland, an online shop with a Las Vegas (USA) contact address and no named company, lists it at EUR 11,373.13 (converted from its base currency) with an order button but marks availability "subject to availability". MagicLab states CE-RED certification is targeted for Q4 2026.

sellers.name: MagicLab (Magiclab Robotics Technology Wuxi)
sellers.note: Enquiry form on the product page; MagicLab names sales and support teams in Germany but no German address.

specs.label: Size standing (L x W x H)
Motors
specs.conditions: 16 body motors plus 1 head motor; 7-inch pneumatic tyres

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: High-performance 8-core CPU plus standard high-performance computing accelerator module

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Lidar, dual camera, depth vision, 4K camera, fisheye camera, ultrasonic sensors, touch sensors, microphone array

specs.label: SDK
specs.value: MagicDog SDK resources (motion control, sensors, status) and ROS 2 interfaces for navigation

notes: No IP rating published; operating range -5 to 40 °C.
Runtime 2 to 4 h; 2 h used here.
Stair climbing is not stated; the maker gives up to 60 cm climbs and drops.
Backplate for extra lidar, gimbals or computing modules.
Roboter Deutschland shows the same price for the legged MagicDog; check the configuration before ordering.
